record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Song<WH07892> <FI>or<Fi> Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> O God<WH0430>, my heart<WH03820> is fixed<WH03559><WTH8737>; I will sing<WH07891><WTH8799> and give praise<WH02167><WTH8762>, even with my glory<WH03519>.
Awake<WH05782><WTH8798>, psaltery<WH05035> and harp<WH03658>: I <FI>myself<Fi> will awake<WH05782><WTH8686> early<WH07837>.
I will praise<WH03034><WTH8686> thee, O LORD<WH03068>, among the people<WH05971>: and I will sing praises<WH02167><WTH8762> unto thee among the nations<WH03816>.
For thy mercy<WH02617> <FI>is<Fi> great<WH01419> above the heavens<WH08064>: and thy truth<WH0571> <FI>reacheth<Fi> unto the clouds<WH07834>. <RF>clouds: or, skies<Rf>

That thy beloved<WH03039> may be delivered<WH02502><WTH8735>: save<WH03467><WTH8685> <FI>with<Fi> thy right hand<WH03225>, and answer<WH06030><WTH8798> me.

God<WH0430> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> in his holiness<WH06944>; I will rejoice<WH05937><WTH8799>, I will divide<WH02505><WTH8762> Shechem<WH07927>, and mete out<WH04058><WTH8762> the valley<WH06010> of Succoth<WH05523>.

Gilead<WH01568> <FI>is<Fi> mine; Manasseh<WH04519> <FI>is<Fi> mine; Ephraim<WH0669> also <FI>is<Fi> the strength<WH04581> of mine head<WH07218>; Judah<WH03063> <FI>is<Fi> my lawgiver<WH02710><WTH8781>;
Moab<WH04124> <FI>is<Fi> my washpot<WH07366><WH05518>; over Edom<WH0123> will I cast out<WH07993><WTH8686> my shoe<WH05275>; over Philistia<WH06429> will I triumph<WH07321><WTH8709>.
Who will bring<WH02986><WTH8686> me into the strong<WH04013> city<WH05892>? who will lead<WH05148><WTH8804> me into Edom<WH0123>?
<FI> Wilt<Fi> not <FI>thou<Fi> , O God<WH0430>, <FI>who<Fi> hast cast us off<WH02186><WTH8804>? and wilt not thou, O God<WH0430>, go forth<WH03318><WTH8799> with our hosts<WH06635>?
Give<WH03051><WTH8798> us help<WH05833> from trouble<WH06862>: for vain<WH07723> <FI>is<Fi> the help<WH08668> of man<WH0120>.
Through God<WH0430> we shall do<WH06213><WTH8799> valiantly<WH02428>: for he <FI>it is that<Fi> shall tread down<WH0947><WTH8799> our enemies<WH06862>.<CM>
